terms.definition: The long coiled tube where digestion finishes and nutrients are absorbed.
terms.function: Absorbs almost all nutrients from food.
terms.whereItIs: Between the stomach and the large intestine.
terms.whyItMatters: It is where your body actually gets its food.

terms.definition: Millions of tiny finger-like projections lining the small intestine.
terms.whereItIs: On the inner surface of the small intestine.
terms.whyItMatters: They give the intestine its huge absorbing surface.

terms.definition: Even tinier projections on each villus.
terms.whyItMatters: They make absorption even more efficient.

terms.definition: The movement of nutrients from the intestine into the blood.
terms.function: Delivers food molecules to the body.
terms.whereItIs: Across the villi in the small intestine.
terms.whyItMatters: It is how food becomes usable by the body.
